title_en: Provisions of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Religious Activities of Aliens Within Chinese Territory

articles.content_en: Article 1 These Provisions are formulated in accordance with the Constitution for the purpose of protecting the freedom of religious belief of foreigners within the territory of the People's Republic of China and safeguarding the public interest.

Article 2 The People's Republic of China respects the freedom of religious belief of foreigners within its territory and protects the friendly exchanges and cultural and academic exchange activities carried out by foreigners with Chinese religious circles in religious aspects.

Article 3 Foreigners may participate in religious activities at monasteries, temples, mosques, churches and other places for religious activities within the territory of China. Upon invitation by a religious group at or above the level of province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government, foreigners may preach scriptures and sermons at places for religious activities in China.
Article 4 Foreigners may hold religious activities participated by foreigners at venues recognized by the religious affairs department of the people's government at or above the county level.
Article 5 Foreigners within the territory of China may invite Chinese religious personnel to perform religious ceremonies such as baptisms, weddings, funerals, and Taoist or Buddhist rites for them.

Article 6 Foreigners entering China may carry religious printed matter, religious audio-visual products and other religious articles for personal use; the carrying into China of religious printed matter, religious audio-visual products and other religious articles exceeding the amount for personal use shall be handled in accordance with the relevant provisions of Chinese Customs.
It is prohibited to carry into China religious printed matter and religious audio-visual products that contain content harmful to the public interest of Chinese society.

Article 7 Foreigners recruiting students for training as religious personnel within the territory of China, or coming to study or lecture at Chinese religious seminaries, shall handle the matter in accordance with the relevant provisions of China.

Article 8 When conducting religious activities within the territory of China, foreigners shall abide by the laws and regulations of China, and may not establish religious organizations, set up religious affairs offices, set up places for religious activities or run religious seminaries within the territory of China, and may not develop followers among Chinese citizens, appoint religious personnel, or carry out other missionary activities.

Article 9 Where foreigners violate these Provisions in conducting religious activities, the religious affairs department of the people's government at or above the county level and other relevant departments shall dissuade and stop them; if the conduct constitutes a violation of the administration of entry and exit of foreigners or a violation of public security administration, the public security organ shall impose penalties according to law; if a crime is constituted, the judicial organ shall investigate criminal liability according to law.
Article 10 These Provisions shall apply to the religious activities of foreign organizations within the territory of the People's Republic of China.

Article 11 For religious activities conducted by Chinese citizens residing abroad within the territory of China, by residents of Taiwan in the mainland, and by residents of Hong Kong and Macao in the mainland, these Provisions shall be referred to for implementation.
Article 12 These Provisions shall be interpreted by the religious affairs department of the State Council.
Article 13 These Provisions shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
